body.p: Grattan street intersects from west to east with Elizabeth Street, Berkley Street, Barry Street, Leicester Street, Malvina Place, Bouverie Street, Little Grattan Street, and Swanston Street.
Notably the Prince Alfred hotel stands on the corner of Bouverie Street and Grattan Street,
opposite the grounds of the University of Melbourne.
University Square is also nestled South of Grattan street, North of Pelham Street, East of Barry Street and West of Leicester Street and has undergone many urban changes.
